{{Top|leg}}
'''Mako Shin-Dar''' was a criminal who operated in [[Ord Mynock Freeport]]. When Shin-Dar heard about an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] courier carrying top secret plans, the criminal decided that it would be a good idea to steal those plans and sell them on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]]. To accomplish this goal, Shin-Dar hired five thugs to assist.<ref name="Game">''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]''</ref>
